spob.text: Brothers,[a] in the name of our Lord Jesus the Messiah, we command you to keep away from any brother whose way of life is disorderly and who does not follow the tradition they received from us.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to keep away from any brother who leads an undisciplined life that is not in keeping with the tradition you received from us.

pob.text: For you yourselves know how you ought to imitate us[a], because we did not behave disorderly among you.

spob.text: After all, you yourselves know how you must imitate us, because we did not live undisciplined lives among you.[a]

pob.text: nor did we eat bread from anyone free of charge[a], but with labor and hardship, working night and day so as not to burden any of you.

spob.text: We did not accept anyone’s bread without paying for it.[a] Instead, we worked hard night and day, enduring hardship, so that we would not be a financial burden to any of you.

pob.text: not because we do not have the right, but in order to give ourselves to you as an example for you to imitate us.

spob.text: We did this, not because we had no right to receive support, but to give you an example through our own conduct—an example for you to imitate.

public_domain_references.kjv: Not because we have not power, but to make ourselves an ensample unto you to follow us.

pob.text: For even when we were with you, we kept commanding you this: if anyone is not willing to work, neither let him eat.

spob.text: After all, even while we were with you, we gave you this command again and again: If anyone is unwilling to work, he should not eat.

public_domain_references.kjv: For even when we were with you, this we commanded you, that if any would not work, neither should he eat.

pob.text: For we hear that some among you are walking disorderly[a], doing no work at all[b], but meddling.

spob.text: For we hear that some among you are walking through life in a disorderly way[a]. They do no work at all; instead, they keep busy meddling.

public_domain_references.bsb: Yet we hear that some of you are leading undisciplined lives and accomplishing nothing but being busybodies.

pob.text: To such people we command and urge in the Lord Jesus the Messiah that[a], working quietly[c][b], they should eat their own bread.

spob.text: In the Lord Jesus the Messiah,[a] we command and urge such people to work quietly and eat their own bread.

public_domain_references.kjv: Now them that are such we command and exhort by our Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.

pob.text: But as for you[a], brothers, do not grow weary in doing good.

public_domain_references.kjv: But ye, brethren, be not weary in well doing.

pob.text: And if anyone does not obey our word through this letter[a], take note of that person; do not associate with him[d][c][b], so that he may be ashamed.

spob.text: If anyone does not obey the instruction we have given in this letter, take note of that person. Do not associate with him, so that he may become ashamed.[a]

pob.text: And do not regard him as an enemy[b][a], but admonish him as a brother.

pob.text: May the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in every way[b][a]. The Lord be with all of you.

pob.text: The greeting is by my own hand—Paul's—which is a sign in every letter[a]; this is how I write.

spob.text: I, Paul, write this greeting in my own handwriting. It is the identifying sign I use in every letter. This is how I write.[a]

pob.text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with all of you[a].
